comments: Bottleneck kernel-size experiment at the SoC input resolution (8 Doppler x 64 Range, see kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64.json). Same architecture and encoder depth as the baseline (/8, bottleneck_ch=64), only bott_c/d1/d2's dw_kernel_size drops 5->3. Rationale: at this resolution the bottleneck feature map is (1,8) spatially, so a 5-wide depthwise kernel mostly convolves over zero-padding rather than real signal -- a mismatch shallow_encoder didn't address (it changed downsampling depth but kept kernel_size=5). Trained from scratch (random init) so kernel size is the only changed variable vs baseline (0.3070 val dice).
